gang_invite_player.description: Invites the player to the gang.

gang_invite_accept.description: Accept a gang join invitation. Accepting one cancels your other pending invitations.

gang_invite_decline.description: Decline a pending gang join invitation.

gang_invite_pending.description: Lists outgoing pending invites from your gang.

gang_ally_request.description: Request alliances to the other gang.

gang_ally_accept.description: Accept a pending alliance request from another gang.

gang_ally_reject.description: Reject a pending alliance request from another gang.

gang_ally_pending.description: Lists outgoing pending ally requests from your gang.

gang_ally_pending_cancel.description: Cancels an outgoing pending ally request.
